descriptions:
Statistical data pattern: structured sports statistics report with consistent numerical formatting (percentages, dollar amounts, rankings) throughout.

Continuation of a specific dollar figure: the sentence is mid-statistic, reporting a year-over-year comparison of total points scored, requiring a specific dollar amount to complete the comparison.

Final token "is" opens a predicate completing "total points scored is," immediately requiring a dollar figure (likely in millions, e.g., "$X million") to finish the comparative clause.

Product listing format with structured metadata fields (Cast, Director, Release Date) followed by promotional description — continuation follows standard film spec/review template.

The description is mid-sentence detailing film quality and technical specs, building toward a complete product description covering cast, crew, and release details.

Final token "is" opens a predicate clause mid-sentence ("The quality of the film is"), immediately requiring a descriptive adjective or noun phrase like "excellent" or "high" to complete the quality assessment.

E-commerce parts catalog listing pattern: structured product category pages with consistent "Part Name + Part Number + Part Description" format throughout.

List continuation momentum: the page is enumerating related parts and categories; the "Related Parts" section has begun with "Part Name" and "Part Number" fields, implying more product entries follow.

Final token "Available" ends a section header "Part Name: Available" — immediately expects a list of part names, part numbers, and descriptions continuing the parts catalog pattern.

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited rows with price ranges, part numbers, and shipping info repeating consistently throughout.

E-commerce price table continuation: the table lists shipping costs and price ranges for parts, with the final row showing "Price Range" and "Price" columns requiring corresponding values.

Final token "–$199.99" is mid-row in the table, part of a price range entry; the next token must complete the table row with a closing pipe delimiter and likely a price value or additional column data.

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited rows with part numbers, prices, and part names repeating consistently throughout the table.

E-commerce parts table continuation: the table lists shipping costs, part names, and prices for auto parts; the "Price" column is partially complete, expecting a dollar amount and closing pipe.

Final token "–$18.00|–$18.00|" closes a table row mid-entry; the next token must continue the table with a new row beginning with "|", likely another part number and price entry.

Structured table pattern: pipe-delimited rows with price ranges, dates, and columns repeating consistently throughout the table.

The table lists shipping costs by price range and date, with the final row showing "$10.00 - $19.99" and a date range, implying a corresponding price value or closing table cell follows.

Final token "$-&- $" is mid-cell in a table row, part of a price range expression; the immediate next token must complete the dollar amount or continue the table cell with a closing pipe or additional data.
